title: The Shepherd and the Water
english: Having subtle and transparent water, the education through Moses was not unconquerably able to guide to truth, yet they trampled the pasture in some manner and disturbed the water, setting forth a thick and earthly impurity, teaching the sheep to follow them like rams. And I will raise up for them one shepherd … my servant David. That he says such things concerning Christ is a thing to be seen without weariness; for the blessed David had already passed away and was already lying in the tombs, and the blessed Ezekiel had foretold indeed. God was performing the promise as something to be fulfilled in due time, and not as something already accomplished; for promises belong to those things which are to be fulfilled, not to those which have already been done.
translator_notes: The text begins and ends mid-sentence; the ellipsis indicates a cut in the source.
The phrase 'οὐκ ἀνικάνως' (not unconquerably) was missing from the previous draft.
